Definition: probably akin to G2932 (through the idea of proprietorship of the manufacturer); to fabricate, i.e. found (form originally):--create, Creator, make.
BiblicalUsage: To create is God's work alone, and the word is used of Him from the beginning to the end. In Colossians 1:16 "by him were all things created," in Ephesians 2:10 we are "created in Christ Jesus unto good works," in 1 Timothy 4:3 the foods are things "which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving," and in Revelation 10:6 the angel swears by Him "who created heaven, and the things that therein are."
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that creation is the ground of everything else I believe: if God made all things, then He owns all things, and if He made me new in Christ, then my life belongs to His purpose. He made all things, and He made me new; both are His work.
